title: Vyrao acquired by Tresalis, names founder Yasmin Sewell Chief Brand Officer
summary: Wellbeing fragrance brand Vyrao’s acquisition by newly established health and beauty platform Tresalis will see founder Yasmin Sewell step into a new role as Chief Brand Officer

extraction.key_fact: 웰빙 향수 브랜드 바이라오가 신설 헬스 및 뷰티 플랫폼 트레살리스에 인수되었으며 창립자는 최고브랜드책임자로 임명되었다.
